r: Tholu Bommalata, Harikatha, Burrakatha, Padya Natakam flagged **close to extinction** (lack of patronage, youth disinterest)
At the **Undavalli Caves**, AP announced an annual **Telugu Mahotsavam** and revival of the **Nandi Natakotsavams**
Originated in the **royal courts**; entertained the court and elites
The chief entertainment of **rural Andhra** besides Yakshagana
The **Jakkula (Jakkula Varu)** community; **Jakkula Purandhri** is a character of the **Yakshaganam**
By **Kandukuri Rudrakavi** – first (published) Telugu Yakshaganam; performed in Telugu with rich costumes and Puranic stories
Yakshaganam became folk theatre and Kuchipudi flourished
Folk forms carried Telugu consciousness to the villages
Dance-song with the dholki, part of **Tamasha** – from **Maharashtra**, not Andhra
